title: MxAgile Requirement
description: Canonical atomic traceable requirement. Canonical location: requirements/REQ-NNN.yml. Primary key: ID. Consumed by build_artifact_index.py for DERIVED_FROM edges (derivedFrom) and IMPLEMENTED_BY edges (spec references).

ID.description: Stable unique identifier. Primary key in the artifact index. Must match filename stem (REQ-001.yml -> ID: REQ-001).

description.description: Requirement text. User story format preferred: 'As a [role], I want [action], so that [value].' For system requirements, plain declarative form is acceptable.

status.description: draft: authored but not reviewed. accepted: approved for implementation. deferred: postponed. superseded: replaced by another requirement.

source.description: Provenance: native = authored directly in MxAgile canonical format, legacy = pre-MxAgile artifact preserved in place, migrated = converted from legacy planning/stories/*.md by the canonicalization lifecycle.

derivedFrom.description: Optional page ID this requirement originates from. Creates a DERIVED_FROM edge in the artifact index: Page -> Requirement.

target_users.description: User roles affected by or relevant to this requirement.

description.description: What this role can do in the context of this requirement.

acceptance_criteria.description: Testable acceptance criteria in Given/When/Then format.

id.description: Stable identifier within this requirement, e.g., AC-001.

business_rules.description: Specific business rules, constraints, or validation logic relevant to this requirement.

entity.description: Mendix entity or concept this rule applies to.

open_items.description: Unresolved DECISION REQUIRED items. A requirement with open_items should not be marked accepted.

business_context.description: Optional: describes the business problem this requirement addresses (Fachliches Problem).

out_of_scope.description: Explicit exclusions to prevent scope creep.

migrated_from.description: Source file path relative to project root, e.g., planning/stories/REQ-001.md. Set by the canonicalization lifecycle. Must be present when source = migrated.

migration_date.description: ISO date when this requirement was converted by the canonicalization lifecycle.
